sloka: अरजस्कं तथा ऽक्षोभ्यं श्रीमत्पक्षिगणायुतम् ।समीपे तस्य सरसो महदद्भुतमाश्रमम् ।। ७.७७.६ ॥
transliteration: arajaskaṁ tathā 'kṣobhyaṁ śrīmatpakṣigaṇāyutam ।samīpe tasya saraso mahadadbhutamāśramam ।। 7.77.6 ॥

translations.english: The lake was pure, undisturbed, glorious, and filled with flocks of birds; and near it was a great and wonderful hermitage.
